title: The panel's declared lists
description: What a declared panel names from this package: the widgets a control is drawn with and the roles that repeat by index. A plugin's own declaration schema references these $defs; tools/modgui-gen.mjs and tools/panel-description.mjs read them.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: The shared widgets a control is drawn with, by the names the console reads (its `auto` is a control left out of `widgets`): a knob or a fader for a travel, a switch for a toggle, a selector for an integer travel or labelled values. The schema, tools/modgui-gen.mjs and the console read this one list; a new one is added here once, and in each renderer, for every plugin.

indexedRole.title: Indexed role
indexedRole.description: The roles that repeat by index, one parameter per band: the only roles that may name a list of symbols.
